name: doubted-security-cost

finding.title: `DedupeLines` scans every kept line for each new one, so a large upload ties up a worker
finding.description: `slices.Contains` walks every line kept so far, so a file of N distinct lines costs about N²/2 comparisons where the map lookup cost one. `handleImport` in `internal/api/import.go` passes the raw body of `POST /import` to `DedupeLines` with no size limit, so any client that uploads a few hundred thousand distinct lines keeps a worker busy for minutes, and a few such requests stall the service.
finding.suggestedFix: Keep the `seen` map for the membership check and append to `out` only for the order.
